name: Hinge Pop
tagline: Snap the hinge. Save the day.

capture.notes: Debug launch flags stage each scene. Build first with make -C ios build.

shots.title: Snap *the hinge*
shots.sub: Drag off the line and it cracks like a whip.

shots.title: Eight visitors. *One gift each.*
shots.sub: Each moves its own way. Catch them if you can.

shots.title: When it glows red, *hit it*
shots.sub: Or its dash takes a whole shield.

shots.title: What you miss lands *on them*
shots.sub: One side each. Your misses are their problem.

shots.title: One stroke, *every bubble*
shots.sub: Then pop one tiny bubble and watch the rest go.

shots.title: Four pictures, *then play*
shots.sub: Twelve world twists, each explained when you meet it.

shots.title: 800 levels, *then endless*
shots.sub: 80 worlds, each bending one rule. Three challenges a level. No ads or accounts.

feature.title: Snap the hinge
feature.sub: Drag off the line. Fling them back.
